game.pool_rule: R' = max(0.01, min(200, R - sum e + 1.4 sum c))

human_selection_rule: the first two by (launch id, CSV row) among the human games of Exps 1-3 of the mechanism with exactly 40 recorded rounds and all four players present in every round
data_attribution: Koster, R. et al. (2025), Nature Communications 16:2824, doi:10.1038/s41467-025-58043-7; data CC BY 4.0

robustness.definition: mean total surplus in a column / the mean of that column's own planner (Planner[column] on its training model); worst_ratio is the minimum over columns

k_tuning.definition: mean total surplus of the deployed Interpolating rule over the C3 tuning games (not the cross-play games) per grid point ln k; k* is the smallest ln k with the maximal mean

distilled.definition: w = weight on the equal split in s_i = (1 - kappa)(w/4 + (1 - w) q_i), least squares per R/200 bin on the planner's own training model (C4 distillation games); seed means

exams.rule_likelihood: next move: delta ell > 0 and its 95 % CI above 0
exams.rule_outcomes: whole game: at least 3 of 4 game metrics inside the widened human CI
